concerns.text: Tasks T004c and T024 implement extraction and regression of `confidence_rating` and `response_time`. These variables are NOT present in spec.md FR-004 (which mandates only fixation, valence, CRT) nor in plan.md (which explicitly removed WYSIATI metrics). This creates a scope violation where the implementation builds an unauthorized model.

Task T006b explicitly forbids `velocity` or `dispersion` thresholds. However, spec.md FR-001 mandates 'I-VT or I-DT' detection. I-DT inherently requires dispersion thresholds. This task blocks a valid spec-authorized implementation path (I-DT).

Task T032 requires reporting 'stability of the three-way interaction coefficient'. Spec.md SC-003 only mandates measuring 'variation in the mean belief rating'. The task adds an unverified success criterion not defined in the spec.

Task T009 mentions 'random seed management' but lacks a concrete implementation task (e.g., a script to pin seeds in `code/`). This fails to satisfy Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires seeds to be pinned in code for every run.

Task T028 instructs generating a fixed 'Causal Framing Statement' regardless of p-values. While FR-006 requires causal framing based on design, the rigid instruction to output a specific string block risks misrepresenting null results, conflicting with Constitution Principle VII (Outcome-Neutral Validation). The task description needs refinement to ensure the framing is design-based but not a hardcoded string that ignores data context.
